headline: LAUSANNE TREATY SIGNED; OTTOMAN PARTITION SETTLED, NEW BORDERS FIXED
dispatch: Delegates from Greece, Turkey, Bulgaria and the Allied powers affixed their signatures today to the Treaty of Lausanne, formally ending the conflicts arising from the Ottoman Empire's dissolution. The agreement draws firm borders for Turkey, Greece and Bulgaria and establishes a massive population exchange between Greece and Turkey. The pact supersedes the earlier, unratified Treaty of Sevres and is expected to bring a measure of stability to the eastern Mediterranean region.
